Tells how many joysticks and gamepads have had a port. One that is unplugged is still counted, and goes on having its port, see [JoyDeviceConnected](JoyDeviceConnected). At most 4 get a port.

```blitzbasic
Graphics 320, 240, 0, 2
SetBuffer BackBuffer()
Cls
For p = 0 To JoyDeviceCount() - 1
	Text 10, 10 + p * 16, p + ": " + JoyDeviceName(p)
Next
Flip
WaitKey
```
@returns The number of ports in use, 0 if no joystick was found.
@gap This is a BlitzLLVM extension: the original has no such command.
